items.learner_visible_instruction: Listen carefully to the audio. Which word did you hear?
items.explanation: The spoken audio clip clearly says 'Hospital'.
items.what_this_question_measures: Basic auditory word discrimination for everyday places.
items.why_each_distractor_is_plausible: All options are common public place nouns that share similar initial consonant sounds or syllable length.
items.accessibility_notes: Clean audio clip at normal speaking rate; clear text buttons.

translation_requirements.te_instruction: ఆడియోను శ్రద్ధగా వినండి. మీరు ఏ పదాన్ని విన్నారు?

items.learner_visible_instruction: Listen to the short dialogue. Where does the speaker want to go?
items.hidden_audio_script: Excuse me, could you tell me which bus goes to the Central Library?
items.explanation: The speaker asks for the bus going to the Central Library.
items.what_this_question_measures: Ability to extract specific destination details from a spoken request.
items.why_each_distractor_is_plausible: All options represent common urban destinations a commuter might ask about.
items.accessibility_notes: Conversational speed audio with standard accent.

translation_requirements.te_instruction: చిన్న సంభాషణను వినండి. మాట్లాడే వ్యక్తి ఎక్కడికి వెళ్లాలనుకుంటున్నారు?

items.learner_visible_instruction: Listen to the train station announcement. Which platform is the train arriving on?
items.hidden_audio_script: Attention passengers, the Intercity Express from Vijayawada will arrive shortly on Platform 4.
items.what_this_question_measures: Auditory number & platform identification under transit announcement conditions.
items.why_each_distractor_is_plausible: Distractors feature phonetically similar numbers (4 vs 14 vs 40).

translation_requirements.te_instruction: రైల్వే స్టేషన్ ప్రకటనను వినండి. రైలు ఏ ప్లాట్‌ఫారమ్‌పైకి వస్తోంది?

items.learner_visible_instruction: Listen to the clinic phone call. What is the caller trying to do?
items.hidden_audio_script: Hello Doctor, I need to reschedule my consultation from Thursday afternoon to Friday morning if possible.
items.explanation: The caller asks to change the consultation time from Thursday to Friday.
items.what_this_question_measures: Identifying main intent in professional service phone calls.
items.why_each_distractor_is_plausible: All options represent common reasons patients telephone a clinic.

translation_requirements.te_instruction: ఫోన్ పిలుపును వినండి. కాలర్ ఏమి చేయాలనుకుంటున్నారు?

items.learner_visible_instruction: Listen to the project update audio clip. What is the speaker's main recommendation?
items.hidden_audio_script: Although our development speed is good, we should extend testing by one week to ensure complete security compliance.

options.text: Extend testing by one week for security

items.explanation: The speaker advises adding a week for security compliance testing.
items.what_this_question_measures: Extracting professional recommendations from multi-clause spoken statements.
items.why_each_distractor_is_plausible: Distractors represent typical software management decisions.

translation_requirements.te_instruction: ప్రాజెక్ట్ అప్‌డేట్‌ను వినండి. మాట్లాడే వారి ప్రధాన సిఫార్సు ఏమిటి?

items.learner_visible_instruction: Tap the microphone and read this greeting aloud:
items.learner_visible_stimulus: Good morning! How are you today?
items.what_this_question_measures: Oral clarity, stress, and intonation on basic social greetings.
items.accessibility_notes: Includes audio preview button so learner can hear model voice first.

translation_requirements.te_instruction: మైక్రోఫోన్‌ను నొక్కి ఈ శుభాకాంక్షను బిగ్గరగా చదవండి:

items.learner_visible_instruction: Imagine meeting a new teammate at work. Tap the microphone and introduce yourself in 1-2 short sentences.
items.learner_visible_stimulus: Example idea: Mention your name and your department or background.
items.what_this_question_measures: Spontaneous oral sentence production for workplace social integration.

translation_requirements.te_instruction: కార్యాలయంలో కొత్త సహోద్యోగిని కలిసినప్పుడు మిమ్మల్ని పరిచయం చేసుకోండి:

items.learner_visible_instruction: Look at the sign shown below. What does this sign tell you to do?

options.text: Do not block this door in case of emergency

items.explanation: An emergency exit sign warns against obstructing safety doors.
items.what_this_question_measures: Functional literacy for critical public safety signs.
items.why_each_distractor_is_plausible: Distractors represent common non-emergency door signs.
items.accessibility_notes: High contrast vector sign graphic with clean alt text.

translation_requirements.te_instruction: సూచికను చూడండి. ఈ సూచన ఏమి చెబుతోంది?

items.learner_visible_instruction: Drag or tap the words in order to form a correct English sentence:
items.explanation: Constructing standard SVO syntax for healthcare requests.
items.what_this_question_measures: Syntactic word ordering capability for everyday service requests.
items.why_each_distractor_is_plausible: Scrambled order tests English Subject-Verb-Object word order rules.
items.accessibility_notes: Both drag-and-drop and tap-to-select interaction enabled.

translation_requirements.te_instruction: సరైన ఆంగ్ల వాక్యాన్ని రూపొందించడానికి పదాలను వరుసగా నొక్కండి:
